resources.string: Enter your server\'s address from tailscale serve and paste the device token from RAFIQ_DEVICE_TOKEN.
Enter an https:// address. The app only talks to your server over HTTPS.
Your server did not answer. Check that Tailscale is on on your phone and that tailscale serve is running on your server. (%1$s)
Something answered, but it is not a Rafiq bridge. Check the address and port.
The bridge refused this address. Add the name to RAFIQ_ALLOWED_HOSTS on your server and restart the bridge.
The bridge refused the token. Paste the value of RAFIQ_DEVICE_TOKEN from your server.
This phone could not finish pairing. Try again.
